test-code.description: an explicitly typed local variable is reported
a var-declared local variable is not reported
a basic for-loop initializer is reported
a var-declared basic for-loop initializer is not reported
an enhanced for-loop variable is reported
a var-declared enhanced for-loop variable is not reported
a try-with-resources declaration is reported
a declaration with no initializer is not reported: var requires one
a null-initialized declaration is not reported: null has no type to infer
an array-initializer shorthand is not reported: var forbids the form
an explicit array allocation is reported: it is not the shorthand form
a lambda initializer is not reported: a lambda needs a target type
a method-reference initializer is not reported: it needs a target type too
a multi-variable declaration is not reported: var forbids multiple declarators
a field is not reported
method and constructor parameters are not reported
a catch parameter is not reported
an explicitly typed lambda parameter is not reported
several declarations in one method are each reported
the rule is skipped below Java 10, where var does not exist
the rule applies from Java 10
